subject: Post-demo: Clarify what prompt/response artifacts Redwood keeps
messages:
From: Tom Harris <tharris@heliumcare.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: quick privacy & retention questions

Thanks for the demo today — that was helpful. A couple of quick items our security and legal teams asked me to confirm before we move to the next internal review: 

1) For the hosted Redwood API path, what prompt/query data and model outputs do you persist by default? Specifically: raw prompt text, model-generated output, derived embeddings, session traces/KV cache snapshots, and any telemetry (latency/cost).

2) What are the default retention TTLs for each of those artifacts, and are they configurable per-account? We need to understand what the default SLA is and whether we can request shorter retention for production.

3) For Dedicated and Private deployments, which of the above artifacts are persisted (if any) by Redwood versus customer-managed storage?

4) Is the prompt/output storage region-aware? Can we pin storage to a single region for EU-only residency?

5) Any standard artifacts you can provide (SOC 2 page, questionnaire answers, or sample data map) to share with Legal?

I'll loop in our contracts mailbox after I get your answers. Thanks — Tom

--
Tom Harris
Head of Product, HeliumCare
tharris@heliumcare.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Tom Harris <tharris@heliumcare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T17:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: quick privacy & retention questions

Tom — thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise, call-friendly snapshot. I'm attaching a one-page data map (redwood-prompt-data-map.pdf) and a simple Q&A sheet we use with Legal. I'll also share SOC 2 pointers in my follow-up.

Summary (hosted API — default behavior):
- Raw prompts (request payload): persisted for 30 days by default for debug/quality analytics. Can be reduced to 0 days for enterprise accounts on request.
- Model outputs (response bodies): persisted for 30 days by default to support reproducing responses and quality monitoring. Optional retention reduction available.
- Derived embeddings: only persisted when a customer calls the embeddings API and chooses to store them; otherwise embeddings are ephemeral unless saved to your vector store.
- Session traces & KV cache snapshots: ephemeral in-memory for serving (not written to long-term storage) except when session snapshot logging is enabled. If enabled, snapshots are kept 7 days by default and are configurable.
- Telemetry (latency, token counts, error rates): aggregated telemetry stored 90 days for platform health; per-request telemetry (no PII) kept 30 days.

Important notes (hosted):
- All persisted artifacts are encrypted at rest with customer-tenant keys in Dedicated/Private, and with our managed KMS in hosted.
- Access to persisted prompt/response artifacts is limited by role-based controls and audited.
- We support region pinning for persisted artifacts on Hosted (EU, US) — ask us to enable EU-only retention for your tenant.

Dedicated & Private:
- Dedicated: persisted artifacts are still managed by Redwood but can be configured with your retention policies and tenant-level KMS.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): by default, no prompt/response data is sent to Redwood-managed storage; customers can choose to enable optional telemetry collection.

Config & controls we recommend for you right now:
- Turn on EU residency for the tenant (HeliumCare) — we can provision that as part of onboarding.
- Set prompt/output TTL to 7 days for production, 0 days for sensitive queries — we'll provide a config toggle in the console + API.
- Enable session snapshot logging only for troubleshooting and set short TTL (3–7 days).

Next steps:
1) I'll drop our one-pager and the HeliumCare-specific answers into the Drive link and send SOC 2 artifact pointers.
2) If you want the shorter retention defaults (7 days / 0 days for sensitive), Ben will prepare a short deployment plan and quote.
3) Send over any legal questions to contracts@heliumcare.com and I'll loop in our Legal.

If you want, we can treat this as a procurement qualification check and set up a brief follow-up call with Ben (solutions) and Marissa (security) tomorrow.

Cheers,

--
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

Thanks — this is great and much clearer. Quick clarifications before we push to Legal: 

- SOC 2 pointers are enough for now; can you share the page or the auditor contact?
- For auditability, we need to retain immutable audit logs for 90 days for all access to persisted prompt/response artifacts. Is that supported as a configurable policy?
- For production we prefer EU-only residency for any persisted artifacts. Please confirm that Hosted EU pinning + 7-day TTL for outputs is feasible.

If you can confirm the three points we can move this into our procurement checklist. I'll schedule contracts intake after that.

Tom
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Legal Intake <contracts@heliumcare.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: quick privacy & retention questions

Tom — quick confirmations inline: 

- SOC 2: yes — we'll share the SOC 2 summary page and a redacted auditor contact. Dropping links to SOC 2 and our standard compliance pack into the Drive link now.
- Immutable audit logs: supported. For Hosted we keep an immutable access/audit log for 90 days by default; we can extend that on request. These logs record role, action, timestamp, and resource id (no raw prompt payloads). We will include an API to export logs to your SIEM (S3/GCS target or syslog).
- EU residency + 7-day TTL: feasible. We can provision EU-only storage for your tenant and set default prompt/output TTL to 7 days for production. We'll include the EU pinning and retention settings in the onboarding checklist.

Attached: redwood-prompt-data-map.pdf (one-page), plus I've created a HeliumCare QA sheet (heliumcare-privacy-qa.xlsx) with the answers above. Ben — can you prepare a short cost delta for TTL changes / EU pinning and drop in the HubSpot deal? Marissa — can you confirm whether session snapshots should default to off for this account?

- Ben Carter: deployment quote and impact (EOD 2026-05-14).
- Marissa Cole: security acceptance note on session snapshot defaults (EOD 2026-05-13).
- Olga: share SOC 2 & Drive link (done), update HubSpot with confirmed deal_id HLMC-2026-0421.

I'll stand by for Procurement/Legal to confirm. Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
